name: Rocky Brands, Inc.
summary: Rocky Brands, Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets footwear and apparel in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through Wholesale, Retail, and Contract Manufacturing segments. The Wholesale segment offers products, which includes sporting goods stores, outdoor retailers, independent shoe retailers, hardware stores, mass merchants, uniform stores, farm store chains, specialty safety stores, specialty retailers, and online retailers in retail locations through a range of distribution channels. Its Retail segment sells its products direct sales to consumers through its websites comprising rockyboots.com, georgiaboot.com, durangoboot.com, muckbootcom…
